create_multiplayer_wrapper: create a Wrapper instance to convert a DMLab2D environment into multiplayer lists of actions and observations
get_multiplayer_observations: use _get_observations to extract per-player observation dictionaries from a DMLab2D source mapping
get_multiplayer_rewards: use _get_rewards to extract per-player reward scalars from a DMLab2D observation mapping
convert_multiplayer_actions: use _get_action to convert a list of per-player action dicts into a flat DMLab2D action mapping
get_multiplayer_action_spec: use action_spec to get a list of per-player action spec dictionaries from the wrapped environment
